requiredBehaviors.behavior: preserve binary identity and template status
requiredBehaviors.evidence: SKILL.md requires source reference, SHA-256, template status and analysis provenance when a binary source exists.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: model section page setup styles headers footers numbering and safe insertion points separately
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The workflow explicitly inventories Sections/Page Setup, named styles, numbering, header/footer variants and bookmarks/content controls.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: distinguish controlled regions from writable insertion points
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The profiler contract separates insertionPoints and controlledRegions and instructs the profiler to mark them distinctly.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: replace the binary template with a reconstructed design
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The binary source remains the Source of Truth and the profile explicitly does not replace it.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: copy unrelated confidential document content into the profile
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The checks explicitly prohibit unnecessary transfer of confidential subject-matter content from the reference.
